# Shibumi 0.2.4

2026-11-14

Fix release for Omarchy 4.5: validated on Omarchy 4.5.0 (package 4.5.0-3, source v4.5.0 at ac2690cd7); forward reference 551dc629. 0.2.0 to 0.2.3 installations update in place.

## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes

- **fix:** show the recording indicator as soon as a recording starts and clear it when the recording ends outside the Shibumi icon; Omarchy 4.5 moved the marker file and may record with wf-recorder (45d27a8c)
- **fix:** bring the dictation indicator back on Omarchy 4.5 by following voxtype directly where the host status helper no longer exists (fabae76b)
- **fix:** refresh the Update Center package count after a package transaction instead of waiting for the next six-hour check (aaf27998)
- **fix:** show today's prompts and sessions and the seven-day token row for OpenCode in the AI panel; the OpenCode reader counted model replies only (reported by a user) (95a0a881)
- **fix:** light the laptop's microphone LED when the microphone is muted from the volume panel, as the microphone key does (0503ac97)
- **fix:** keep the microphone level bar in the volume panel within the slider track (246e9c9b)
- **fix:** give the version row on the Health page the same padding on the left as on the right (465c0fa2)
- **fix:** remove the empty band below the profile buttons in the Power Profile panel; its status line now appears only for an error (530ca12a)

### Performance

- **perf:** skip the provider discovery after a shell restart when the last one is younger than six hours (20fdee07)
- **perf:** read the audio output availability on PulseAudio events instead of every five seconds (b7f2b412)
- **perf:** read the active power profile on its change signal instead of every five seconds (4ddfed92)

### Maintenance

- **test:** pin forward compatibility to Omarchy quattro 551dc629 (78c04616)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4
